Commentary.Commentary: Thus, there is a lead of 142. It is surely a good and handy one to have on this surface which is only expected to deteriorate with time. Afghanistan's spinners will be licking their lips and it is all up to the Irish batsmen to put their head down and bat well in their second innings. Will they? We will have to wait and watch... Resumption in a bit.

As for the bowling of the visitors, they looked set to be in for a long toil after a wicketless first session. The second new ball though brought them relief as Afghanistan lost their last 7 wickets for just 88 runs. All the bowlers used were among the wickets other than Kevin O'Brien. Thompson stood out with three wickets.

The innings was about three batsmen who reached their respective maiden fifties in Test cricket. Hashmatullah Shahidi was an epitome of patience while Asghar Afghan was the attacking batsman at the end. The main and the best batsman of the innings though would have to be Rahmat Shah who played beautifully but was unfortunate to have fallen 2 short of his ton. The rest of the batsmen got starts and had bits and pieces innings but could not carry on, hence the hosts ended with 314.

The Irish would be really happy with the way things have gone in the last two sessions at least. There was a chance that they could have been staring at a really big lead but the second new ball has done the trick for them and the lead has been restricted to 142.

OUT EDGED! TAKEN! Afghanistan have been bowled out. The last batsman falls to a short ball pitching on middle and climbing onto his body. He tried to play it off the back foot but ends up edging it straight to Balbirnie at first slip who makes no mistake in taking it. The umpire goes upstairs to check if it was a fair delivery. Replays show there was some part of his foot behind the line. Fair delivery and the batsman is out.
A length delivery on off, Wafadar drives the ball crisply straight to mid on.
Full on off, defended with the straight bat.
Fuller in length and driven to mid off. The fielder is slow in reacting and the batsman steals a single.
Punched of the back foot and played to the covers. One run taken.
Defends this straight into the ground.
Bye! Goes for the pull on this one but fails to get bat on ball. They take a run. Bye signaled.
Wafadar tries to heave this over mid-wicket but gets it of the inside half of the bat and straight to short mid-wicket. No run.
Full on off, defended off the front foot.
Slightly fuller this time on the off stump, Waqar comes ahead and defends it onto the ground.
On a length outside off, Salamkheil defends from the crease.
Waqar Salamkheil is the number 11 bat.

OUT! That is the end of the Afghanistan skipper. A length ball wide outside off, Afghan chases after the ball and looks to cut it but gets a thin under edge as the ball goes through to the keeper who takes a good low catch. End of an entertaining innings, the Irish can now hope to restrict the lead under 150.
A length delivery on leg and middle, Afghan keeps that away with the use of his wrist.
Back of a length, defended with ease.
Full length delivery on middle and leg, Afghan keeps it away.
Stuart Thompson is on to bowl now.

Drinks Break! It has been a decent session for both sides but the Afghans will be the happier ones. Their lead has swelled up to 139 runs and they will hope to add as many as possible for the last two wickets. Meanwhile, the tourists would like to clean off the last two as soon as possible because these lusty blows might come later to haunt them. The final period of play of the day to follow...
A fuller length delivery, almost a yorker on off. Wafadar managed to put the bat down in time and keeps it away.
Full outside off, Wafadar fails to put his bat on that.
Full on middle and leg, Wafadar keeps it away.
A full length delivery pitching outside off, Wafadar almost falls for the trap and gets beaten.
A length delivery on middle and leg and Wafadar defends it.
A short of a length ball on around off, defended towards the cover region.
SIX! Huge, that is really big! A flighted ball on middle, Afghan comes down the track and lifts the ball way over long on for a maximum. The field was up and the Afghan skipper took the invitation.
Short and wide outside off, Afghan pushes it towards point.
Flighted on the middle stump line, Asghar comes ahead and defends the ball back to the bowler.
Shorter this time outside off, Momand looks to cut but gets the ball off the inside half and away from the slip fielder for a single.
Flighted outside off, pushed towards cover by Wafadar away from his body.
Flatter one outside off, pushed back towards the bowler.

FOUR! Now he is just playing around with the Irish bowling attack. The bowler is not impressed. A length delivery on middle and off, Asghar makes room early and lifts it above mid off for another boundary. Afghan is wasting no time here to score runs. He is trying to hit almost every ball. Does he have a declaration in mind here?
FOUR! 300 up for Afghanistan! A length ball on off, Asghar makes room and smashes it hard above the mid off fielder for a boundary.
Full on off, blocked with ease.
Pitching fuller on off, Afghan blocks it.
A length ball on off, defended with ease.
A back of a length delivery on off, angled in for Asghar and he defends it with ease.
Tim Murtagh to bowl now.
Prods forward and keeps this one out.
FOUR! LOFTED! The tail ender is in action now. Sees a tossed up ball pitched on off, goes in with the shot and lofts it high over mid-off. The ball races away to the fence after a bounce.
Comes forward and blocks it with ease.
Momand defends it from within the crease.
Flights this one, Momand drives it straight to mid-on.
Tossed up on off, blocked firmly.
No run.
SIX! Handsome shot! And that's his fifty, captain leading from the front. A floated delivery on off, Afghan dances down the pitch and lifts it above the bowler's head for a maximum.
A good comeback by the bowler. Full on off and Asghar defends it with ease.

SIX! Asghar is looking to extend the lead as big as possible now. A flighted delivery on off and Asghar dances down the wicket and gets to pitch if the ball and connects well and lifts it above mid on for a huge hit. Six runs added to the total.
A back of a length on off, defended by Asghar.
Full on off, defended with ease.
A front foot defense to this flighted ball outside off. Momand does well.
Pushed towards point off the back foot.
Wafadar Momand is the next batsman in.

OUT! Another one falls to the spin of Dockrell. Ahmadzai the man in question this time. A flatter one on middle, the batsman looks to defend but fails to put bat on ball as he plays down the wrong line. It raps the pad in front of leg stump, the fielders appeal and the finger goes up in an instant. Looked like it may have missed the leg stump to the naked eye but it doesn't matter now.
Flighted outside off, Asghar comes ahead and defends the ball onto the ground towards the off side. Single taken.
FOUR! Well done! A flatter one and straying down on the pads, Afghan works it really fine and beats short fine leg. A boundary results as the fielder cannot reach the ball.
Flatter one and really full on middle, Ahmadzai hits it wide of mid on for a single.
Shorter in length this one, Afghan goes on the back foot and plays it to the off side.
Tossed up on off, driven straight to mid on.
Ahmadzai punches this one on the front foot to the covers. The batsman take a single in the process.
Defends this one by getting right behind the line of the ball.
Floated this one on middle and Afghan clips to the mid-wicket region for a single.
Flighted on off, Afghan strides forward and blocks it.
Tossed up on off, pushed towards covers. Dot to end the over.

OUT! Plumb LBW. And that's how I make a comeback says the bowler. A quicker one this time, pitched on middle and leg and turned in for the right-harder. Rashid tried to defend it but the ball missed his bat and stuck hard on Rashid's pads. Irish gave a loud appeal and the umpire declared that out. The replay shows that Rashid's bat didn't come down in time, and the bat got stuck. He makes his way back thus, and is replaced by Yamin Ahmadzai.

SIX! And that brings the 100-run lead for the Afghans. Beauty shot that! A flighted delivery that was asked to be hit. The ball pitched on off and a good length area. Rashid dances down the track and lofts it above covers with the spin.
FOUR! A flighted delivery, pitched on off, Rashid just drags it from the off and sweeps it to the vacant square leg area and thats a boundary.
A length delivery on off, Asghar just taps it to the covers region and runs for a single.
Full on off,  defended with ease.
Flighted on middle, the Afghan skipper walks down the track and flicks it slightly uppishly towards the right of mid-wicket. A single is taken and he retains strike.
A touch shorter this time, worked towards square leg off the pads. No run though.
Full and outside off, pushed to cover by Afghan.
Really full this time, AA looks to flick it away but the ball goes on to his shoe after the ball. The ball goes towards the bowler.
Flatter on middle, worked towards mid-wicket by Afghan.
Flatter one on the pads, turned away towards the leg side by Asghar towards fine leg.
Leans forward to this ball and shows the full face of the bat.
Tossed up on off, played on the front foot.
Goes back on this ball and punches it to the cover region. Another dot.
Perfect timing on this one, but driven straight to the covers.
Driven through the covers, finds the gap beautifully. A run completed.
FOUR! Smacked! Hits this flighted ball straight down the ground. One bounce and into the fence. The skipper is in action now. Can he bat with the tail and get a sizable lead in the innings?
Changes the angle and comes from over the wicket. Tossed up on off, played away to the short mid-wicket fielder.
Rashid Khan is next to bat.

OUT! BOWLED! A beautiful delivery. A flighted delivery, just as planned it seems. We saw the same approach on the previous delivery, almost same air to the ball, pitched fuller on off and middle line. Khil was just looking for a flick, but missed the ball completely as he yorks himself getting too close to the ball, with the leg stump getting hit. McBrine has deserved this wicket and the young debuntant, Khil has to walk back to the pavilion. Ireland now into the bowlers.
A beautiful loopy delivery on off, Khil going for a wristy flick around thhe mid on region but gets an edge, just falls short to bowler.
A quicker one in the air, on off, with fuller length, defended with ease.
A short of a length delivery on middle and leg, Afghan flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
A flighted delivery on off, defended with ease.
Flighted on off, blocked from within the crease.
Fuller ball, hit hard and straight back to the bowler.
Defended by getting right behind the line of the ball.
Goes on the back foot and plays it to the covers.
Goes on the back foot and plays it to mid on. The batsman takes a single.
Flighted on off coming in, Afghan plays it on the on side but it hits the fielder at short leg.
Flighted on middle, Khil stays nice and high before timing this ball down the ground past the bowler to his left. A couple of runs are taken.
Flatter and hurled on the middle stump line, pushed off the back foot towards mid-wicket.
Flatter and bowled on the middle stump, Khil stands tall and defends the ball with a straight bat.
Quicker through the air on middle, AA works it on the leg side. A quick single is taken.
Flatter one on middle, kept out watchfully by the Afghan skipper.

FOUR! What a sweep! Took some dust off the pitch as well. A flatter one on the off stump line, Asghar gets real low and sweeps this hard through square leg for a boundary. The 250 comes up for the hosts.
Tossed up delivery on off, defended of the back foot.
Pitches this one full and on leg, Khil sweeps it but straight to the fielder at leg gully.
The batsman rocks back and  works it down the leg side. No run scored.
Blocks out this floated ball from the font foot.
Tad shorter this time, defended off the back foot.
Tossed up on off, Afghan shows the full face off the bat and drives it through covers. One run taken.

Woahh! Some good spin there! This one is tossed slow and outside off, Khil comes ahead and realises he is foxed by the flight. The ball takes the outside edge as he tries to keep it out away from the body. The ball runs wide of slip for a couple of runs.
Shorter one outside off, the southpaw goes back and cuts but the ball goes straight to the point fielder.
Flighted this time on middle, Khil prods ahead and defends this towards the off side.
Flatter and quicker on middle, Ikram punches it away to cover.
Flatter one on leg stump, pushed back to long on for a single by the Afghan skipper.
Flatter ball on the off stump, Asghar keeps it out towards cover.
Andy McBrine to bowl now from the other end.
Shows the full face of the bat and blocks it out.
Bowls this one a little shorter, Khil is quick to go back and get bat on ball.
Similar delivery, similar result.
Khil plays this off the back foot and keeps it out.
This one is bowled on off, placed towards cover.
Tossed up on off, flicked on the leg side for a dot.

Welcome back for the final session. 33 overs left. Can Ireland make the most of the time remaining? A wicket here and they can enter into the bowlers. George Dockrell to start the proceedings after Tea. Ikram Ali Khil to face. Here we go.
... DAY 2, SESSION 3 ...

Overall, the Afghans are 70 runs ahead and another 30-40 should put them in good stead, with the pitch expected to break up come Day 3. Afghan though, will aim to bat for as long as possible and try and reach that elusive 400. Can Ireland get to bat tonight? 33 overs left in the day. Join us back at 3 pm local (0930 GMT).

A better session for the viewers. 3 wickets means that there was some excitement in the 2-hour period, for 85 runs. Rahmat Shah and Hashmatullah Shahidi threatened to make it another wicketless session before the latter fell to a poor shot. Rahmat then fell agonizingly close to a century while Nabi threw his wicket away.
Almost in the block hole, Afghan digs it out and keeps it to the off side. TEA ON DAY 2, AFGHANISTAN LEAD BY 70!
Angles this one in from the middle stump line. Afghan plays it to the on side.
Keeps out this ball on the off stump line.
Pitched on off angling in, driven straight to the bowler.
Quicker this time, Afghan goes back and flicks it on the on side.
Fuller on off, blocked on the front foot by Afghan.
Landed outside off, driven straight to cover.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
Walks down the track, pushes it towards point and takes a run.
Full and around middle, stays low a touch, flicked through square leg for a couple.
Down the leg side, flicked through square leg for a single.
Full and wide outside off, driven through the covers for a couple.
Defends this by getting right behind the line of the ball. Dot ball to follow the six.

SIX! HIGH and HANDSOME! Bowls a length delivery on off, Afghan reads it early and lofts it high in the sky on the on side. The ball just crosses the ropes wide of deep mid-wicket. Second six of the innings.
Fuller this time, driven straight back to the bowler.
Similar length, similar result.
Bowls it just outside off, Afghan plays it off the back foot.
Full ball pitching on off, defended off the front foot.

On the leg stump lying once more, Khil looks to glance the ball but misses it. The ball takes the pad before going to the keeper. There is an appeal from the fielders due to the noise but the umpire is not fooled.

Fuller length ball on the leg stump, Khil looks to flick but fails to put bat on ball. Is struck near the pad and the players appeal but the umpire says not out. Looked like it would have been going down leg.
Wide! Sprayed way, way, way outside off and it is signalled wide by the umpire. Imagine how wide it must be to be signalled as a wide in Tests on the off side.

Oooh! Close! Ikram does not look too comfortable playing out there. A length ball on the off stump line, Khil looks to defend that one but gets the inside edge. Luckily for him, the ball hits the pads.
Khil has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
This one is on the pads, Asghar looks to flick but fails to put bat on ball. There is an appeal as the ball hits the pads but it was going well down leg side. A leg bye is stolen.
On a length outside off, pushed to the point region by Asghar.
Length ball on middle, Khil goes on the back foot and plays it to point.
Full ball outside off, played off the back foot to the mid-wicket region.
The batsman has driven that ball straight back to the right of the bowler.
Straighter this time, Ikram moves across and defends it straight to the bowler.
Length ball on the pads, defended off the back foot.
Fuller ball angling in on the pads, Afghan nudges it fine on the leg side and takes a run.
On a length outside off, pushed towards the point region by Ikram.
Fuller length ball, landing on middle and swinging inward. Khil pushes it back to the bowler.
Ikram  Ali Khil walks out to bat at number 7.

OUT! Would you believe it? Nabi has given it right to mid-wicket. Afghanistan lose two in quick succession. A fuller length ball on the pads, Mohammad looks to flick it away but does not keep it down. The ball goes straight to Cameron-Dow who stays low to take a good catch. The bowler pumps his fists in delight. The Irish have found some mojo here with the new ball. Very loose from the hosts on the other hand.
Leg bye! Bowls this one straying down leg, Nabi tries to work it fine but misses to get bat on ball. It hits his pads and goes on the on side. The batsman takes a run. Leg-Bye signaled.
Punched of the back foot to the point region.
Full ball pitching outside off, some away shape on it. Afghan drives it straight to covers.
On the middle stump line, worked away towards mid-wicket.
Wide outside off, left alone by Nabi.
Mohammad Nabi joins his skipper in the middle.

OUT! Oh no! He has dragged on! Rahmat is distraught, what have you done? A length ball wide outside off, Shah looks to cut this ball away from his body lazily without much foot movement but the ball goes off the inside edge and onto the middle stump. He looks crestfallen! There is a check for a no ball but no, the bowler makes no mistake while landing. He has to walk away just 2 short of his ton. An anti-climax of sorts, well played though. The lead now reads 54.
Length outside off once more, Rahmat pushes it to cover.
On a length outside off, defended off the back foot by Rahmat.

Long discussion between the bowler, skipper and Paul Stirling. Oh wait, there is a helmet coming onto the field. There is a very close slip now, probably because of the ball failing to carry to a regulation slip on this surface.
On a length outside off, Rahmat defends it towards cover.
Tim Murtagh to share the new ball.
Length ball on the pads, the batsman flicks it on the on side.
Full ball swinging away, Afghan pokes at it but fails to get bat on ball. Lucky that it did not take the edge.
Drives it well but to the fielder at covers.
Full ball driven straight to the bowler.
Short ball to follow up a full toss, left alone by the batsman.
Bowls a full toss to start it off, some away swing on that. Punches it with a stretch of hands, to the point region for a single.
The second new ball is now available. It is taken immediately by the Irish. Stuart Thompson will bowl with it.
Worked away towards the leg side by Afghan. No run though as the ball goes straight to the fielder.
Flatter one on the middle stump, defended back down the ground by AA.
Hurled wide down the leg side, Asghar looks to pull it away but fails to put bat on ball.
Flatter one on the middle stump, pushed to the leg side by the Afghan skipper, Afghan.
Flighted on middle, Shah comes down the ground and pushes the ball to long on for a single. Moves on to 97!
Flatter one on middle, defended onto the ground by Rahmat.
1 over to go before the second new ball will be available... Meanwhile in the break between the overs, the umpire is seen explaining the reason for giving wides to James Cameron-Dow.
Afghan goes on the front foot and drives this full ball straight to mid off.
Fuller in length, Shah goes down the track and punches it straight to the right of the bowler. The fielder at long off cuts it out. One run taken.
Afghan flicks this away with a wristy shot on the leg side. One run added to the total.
Shah goes on the back foot and flicks it of his pads to the on side for a single.
Kept out by Shah. Finally, tosses it up on leg and bowls a legal delivery.
Wide! Another one. 3 wides in a row. Continues to bowl negative, the umpire signals wide.
Wide! Similar delivery, similar result.
Wide! Bowls it outside leg. Negative bowling by Cameron, wide singaled.
FOUR! On 94 now! Drags this one short and way outside off, Rahmat rocks back and punches it through the covers for a boundary.
Flatter through the air, Rahmat pushes it back towards mid on and runs through for a single. He keeps strike. Rahmat moves into the 90s with this shot.
A flighted ball on the off stump line, Rahmat comes ahead and dead-bats the ball.
Short and some width outside off, Afghan backs away a little and hits this hard to the left of mid off for a single.
A good front foot defence from Asghar to this flatter one outside off.
Flatter one on middle, Asghar rocks back and punches it back towards the bowler.
Flatter one on middle, pushed back towards mid-wicket by Afghan coming down the track.
Flighted on off, Shah reads the length and dances down the track to take it as a full toss and plays it uppishly down the ground to complete a brace.
Shah blocks this out off the front foot.
Leans forward and keeps it to the ground.
Tossed up on leg, Afghan flicks it off his pads to the mid-wicket region for a single.
Fuller on off, driven to the covers.
Starts his new spell with a tossed up ball on middle, played back to the bowler.

Drinks Break! The Irish have managed to breakthrough the huge 3rd-wicket stand. The runs though are coming nice and easy for the home side. Their lead now is 37 runs. The skipper, Asghar Afghan has joined Rahmat Shah who has looked ominous out in the middle and primed to be Afghanistan's first centurion. The match is pretty much in favour of the Afghans unless they lose wickets in heaps now. James Cameron-Dow to bowl post Drinks.
Flatter one and going down the leg side, Shah sweeps that ball but cannot find the gap. The ball rolls to fine leg.
Flatter one on the off stump, Rahmat stays in the crease and keeps the ball out.
Flighted on the off stump, Afghan comes ahead and defends the ball onto the ground.
Worked off the pads to deep mid-wicket for a single by the skipper. Easy run as the fielder is really deep.
Flatter one on middle, pushed back to shortish mid on.
Flatter one on middle, kept out by Asghar off the back foot towards short leg.
Full ball outside off, Shah goes on the back foot and punches it to cover-point.

The batsman pulls out... looks like something distracted him there. The bowler is not impressed. Actually on the replay, we see the Kevin was looking elsewhere while running on to bowl. Rahmat moves away.
Bowls it on the pads, flicks it on the on side for a quick single.
Shorter in length this time, the batsman pulls it off his back foot to the mid-wicket region. A run taken.
Length ball on off, driven to the covers. The fielder stops it easily.
Full ball on off, punched to the covers for no run.
Shah keeps it out off the front foot.

FOUR! It was really high in the air but had enough power on it to clear the deepish mid on. A flighted ball outside off, Asghar Afghan goes for the big one over long on but he does not get much distance. The ball goes really high and over the head of a deep mid on who runs backward to try and take the catch. He cannot reach there and the ball goes on to trickle over the rope.
A length ball outside off, the skipper comes ahead and dead-bats this one.

Tossed up around leg, Rahmat goes for the sweep and gets it of the inside half of the bat. The ball goes to the fine leg region where the fielder gives a chase and manages to stop it just inside the ropes. Three runs given.
Full and outside off again, watchfully kept out.
Comes forward this time and blocks.
Full and around off, defended from the crease.
Full length delivery outside off, driven to mid on off the toe end of his bat.
Shorter in length, Afghan rocks back and tries to pull but misses it altogether. The ball goes straight in the keeper's gloves.
Tad fuller in length, Rahmat moves across and flicks it off his pads to change strike.
Similar length, pushed to the cover fielder this time.
Length ball angling in, defended in front of his pads.
Full and outside off, punched of the back foot to the point fielder.
Flatter one outside off first up to the skipper, Afghan pushes it towards mid-wicket coming a little ahead.
Captain Asghar Afghan walks out to the middle.

OUT! The bowling change has worked! McBrine strikes! A flatter one on middle, Shahidi has a brainfade moment. The ball is really full and Hashmatullah instead of playing with a straight bat, decides to sweep. He misses the ball and is rapped in front of the middle stump. The appeal is a loud one and the finger of S Ravi goes up swiftly. The 130-run stand comes to an end and Shahidi has to depart after a really good knock. Ireland will now look to make use of this breakthrough and pick up a few more really quickly.
Flatter one outside off, defended onto the ground.

Loud appeal but the umpire is unmoved! A peach of a delivery. Flighted just outside off and turning away from the southpaw, Shahidi who looks to defend is just beaten by the spin. The ball skims past the outside edge and goes to the keeper.
Flighted outside off, pushed back to the bowler by the lefty.
Flatter one on the off stump line, pushed back towards the bowler.
Andy McBrine is now back on.
Length ball punched of the back foot to the cover region.
Back of a length delivery, guided to the third man region for a single.
Leans forward on this full ball, played to covers.
Another length delivery, pushed to the point region.
Shah defends this off the back foot to the off side.
Length ball way outside off, guided straight to the hands of the point fielder.
FOUR! Wide outside off, Hashmatullah cuts it really late and the ball goes really fine to the third man boundary. No chance for any fielder there. An expensive over comes to the end, 10 runs off it.
A flatter one outside off, pushed away through point for a couple of runs by HS. The batsmen ran well there.
FOUR! Superb shot! A flighted ball outside off and with some width, Shahidi smashes it through covers. The ball races away to the rope. All too easy for the batsmen now in the middle.
Quicker through the air outside off, Hashmatullah stands in his crease and keeps the ball out.
Pushed back to the bowler showing the full face of the bat by the southpaw.
Slower through the air and full outside off, Shahidi though defends it off the back foot. The ball goes off the outside half and wide of slip.
FOUR! Straying down the leg stump line, Shah moves across and clips it off his pads to the vacant fine leg region. Boundary signaled.
Full on leg stump line, plays it straight to mid on. The fielder stops it with ease.
Defends it presenting the full face of the bat.
Shah defends it by getting right behind the line of the ball.
Plays it off the front foot and into the ground.

FOUR! CRISP and CLEAN! Starts off with a full ball angling away, Rahmat leans forward and drives it cleanly through the gap. What makes it even better is that there were 3 fielders, one at cover, one at extra cover and one at mid off. He trisected them with perfection. No stopping those. It races away to the fence.
Kevin O'Brien comes into the attack now.
Flighted outside off, Shahidi comes ahead and defends the ball into the ground.
Flatter one on the pads, flicked away for a single to deep mid-wicket by RS.
Shah has offered no stroke to an incoming delivery which lands outside the leg stump.
The ball is down the leg side and the batsman wants nothing to do with it. He tries to keep it out with his body.
FOUR! Good shot! Brilliant placement. On a shorter length outside off and cut away by Rahmat behind point for a boundary. He looks really in full control out there now.
Bowled way down the leg side, Rahmat does not want anything to do with that ball.
Shahidi goes on the back foot and cuts it to the cover-point region.
Drives it nicely through the covers but no run taken.

FIFTY! It has been a slow knock but Shahidi has looked comfortable in his innings. Length ball outside off, Shahidi opens the face of the bat and guides it to third man. The fielder at backward square leg gives it a chase and the batsman complete two.
Blocks this out presenting the full face off the bat.
Similar length, punched towards the covers.
Full on off, defended off the front foot.
On the leg stump line once more, kept out by Rahmat using his body. 7 runs off this over.
Another one well down the leg side, RS pads it away.
Bowls this down the leg side on a negative line, Shah offers no shot.

FOUR! Short and punished by Rahmat. On a shorter length and leg stump line, Shah rocks back and pulls it away wide of mid on for a boundary. Afghanistan also go past the Ireland total with this shot, they take the lead for the first time in Test cricket. Runs are flowing now.
Flighted outside off, pushed away to deep cover for a single.
Short outside off, Shahidi cuts it late and pushes the ball wide of backward point. A couple is taken. The 100-run stand comes up between these two.
Another dot to end the over. Shah pushes the ball on length and leg stump line back down the ground.
Slightly straighter one and on length, pushed back towards mid on.
FOUR! Nice timing! A length ball outside off and driven in the gap through the covers by Rahmat. The ball goes to the rope once it beats the infield.
Pushed from the crease towards the point region.
On the off stump line, Shah comes ahead and dead-bats this one.
Fuller length ball on the leg stump, pushed back towards the bowler.
The batsman was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.
Shahidi has driven it straight down the ground single.
The batsman plays the pull-shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.

BEAUTY! That's a RIPPER! Pitches this one on leg and turns it in, Shah was beaten altogether. He had no clue how that gripped off the pitch and beat his outside edge. The ball nearly missed the top of off pole. Poynter collects it quickly and takes the bails off. No trouble there.
Tossed up on leg, played to the on side.
Flatter on off, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
Driven straight to the covers but no run taken.
Shah blocks it out off his front foot.
Similar length, similar result.
Blocked right off the meat of the bat and the ball rolls towards covers.
Clips this length ball off his pads to square leg for a single.
Murtagh bowls it full and on off, Shahidi leans forward and defends it.
Tim Murtagh to bowl from the other end.
Pushed away to deep point off the back foot for a single by Rahmat Shah as he keeps strike.
Flighted one outside off, HS defends it onto the ground coming ahead.
Flatter one on off stump, Hashmatullah stands tall and keeps the ball out.
Flighted outside off, Shahidi comes ahead and pads the ball away.
Flatter one on the middle stump, Rahmat mistimes his pull to long on for a single.
From over the wicket, Rahmat clears his front foot and defends this onto the ground to this ball on the leg stump.

Welcome back for the second session of the second day. The Irish looked out of ideas in the first session but did well to at least keep the run rate on the lower side. They will need wickets early. Meanwhile, Hashmatullah Shahidi and Rahmat Shah will look to continue the good job they have been doing. The umpires and players are out in the middle, James Cameron-Dow to bowl the first over of the post-Lunch session.
... Day 2, Session 2 ...

So what now? The away side are in a really big spot of bother here. They need wickets in heaps and that too quickly if they are to restrict the Afghanistan lead to a manageable one. The way things are going though, they might be staring at one long day in the field. Will that be the case or can the visitors' bowlers provide some magic? Join us at 1240 local for the post-Lunch session!

The session began slowly when both batsmen were just defending the balls and runs were difficult to come by. After the Drinks break though, the pitch eased out and it seemed the Irish lost their persistence to bowl in good areas. Runs came by easily and the batsmen looked in no trouble at all. As for the bowlers, there is some purchase on the wicket for the spinners but it is slow turn so far and it has been dealt with by the batters.

What a session this has been for the 'hosts', 30 overs bowled and 67 runs scored for the loss of no wickets. They are well and truly on top here, having cut the deficit down to just 15 runs. Rahmat Shah and Hashmatullah Shahidi have ground out the Irish bowlers in the morning session and walk into a well-deserved Lunch break for them. The former got to his fifty, the first-ever by an Afghan in Tests.
Shahidi defends this tossed up ball outside off from within the crease. AND THAT WILL BE LUNCH ON DAY 2!

Shahidi flicks this one off his pads to the square leg region. Initially they go for the run but then change their mind mid-way through and go back to their end. Luckily there was no confusion there otherwise a good session for them could have ended in a bad manner with a run out.
Shah punches this one off the back foot to the off side. The deep point runs in quickly and stops it in the cover region. One run completed.
Driven towards mid-off with no intentions of running. Another dot.
Shahs shows full face of the bat and keeps this out.
Floated one outside off, defended straight back to the bowler.

Another appeal and the umpire, S Ravi is unmoved yet again. A flatter one on off stump this time, Shahidi looks to pad the ball away but the turn causes the ball to go really close to the gloves and handle of the bat. The ball though just lobs off the pads and goes towards short leg who pouches it. The Irish are celebrating but the umpire's finger is firmly in his pocket.

There is an appeal there but the umpire is unmoved! A flighted ball outside off and turning inward. Shahidi prods ahead and pads it away. The ball goes really close to the glove and the face of the bat so there is an appeal after slip takes that ball. The replays though show there was nothing on it.
Lots of air on this one, Rahmat takes that on the full and flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter length ball on middle, pulled away to deep square leg for a single by the southpaw.
Bowled wide outside off, Shahidi covers the line of the ball and then puts his body in the way.
A flatter one outside off, driven along the ground to deep cover for a single by Shah.
Shahidi goes back to this full ball and blocks it straight to the bowler.
Prods forward and keeps it out.
Shah drives this full ball straight to long on for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Similar line and length, Shah played it to short mid-wicket this time.
Floated on off, punched back to the bowler.
Andy McBrine to bowl now.

FOUR! Brilliant shot against the spin. Flighted well outside off, Shahidi leans into the drive. The ball was too close to the batsman for any turn to happen and it is pushed away wide of cover for a boundary. That brings up the 150 for the Afghans! The deficit is just 20 now.

Slower through the air this time but way outside off. The ball causes an explosion once more as it turns but the line was bad so no worries. Shahidi comes to the line and then offers no shot, padding the ball away.
Flatter one on the off stump, pushed back towards the bowler.
Flighted outside off, pushed back towards the bowler.
Much better from Dow! A lenght ball tad outside off and it turns sharply inwards, Hashmatullah manages to keep it out towards short leg.
FOUR! Poor ball and punished! A drag down outside off, almost half way down the pitch, Shahidi rocks back and pulls it away through square leg for a boundary.
Short ball outside off, Shahidi goes for the pull and gets it of the inside half of the bat. The ball rolls to the mid-wicket region. One run added to the total.
Shahidi picked that bouncer early and let it through to the keeper.
Fuller this time, punched off the back foot to the fielder at point.
Length ball on off, defended by getting right behind the line of the ball.
Clips this full ball off his pads to the fine leg region and they take a run.
On a length outside off, patted towards cover by the batsman from the crease.
Flighted on off and turning in. A bit of bounce on that too, Shahidi manages to keep it out off his front foot.
Driven to the right of the bowler this time. Another dot. There was a puff of dust that rose when this ball landed outside the off stump on the rough.
Punches it straight back to the left of the bowler.
Nudges this tossed up delivery off his pads to the square leg region for an easy single.
Comes forward on this one and plays it to the on side.
Flatter and shorter on off, defended off the back foot.
Length ball outside off, pushed towards a fielder positioned at cover-point.
On a length and driven back down the ground to mid off.

Good running! A length ball outside off and Shahidi cuts the ball in the gap through point. The batsmen run back for the second and a better throw would have had the batsman at the keeper's end in trouble. 2 runs though are completed.
Slightly fuller this time outside off, driven hard to a cover who is a little deep. No run taken though.
Another one really not rising high, well outside off. Hashmatullah looks to cut but fails to put bat on ball.
Short and wide outside off, keeps a bit low. Shahidi misses the cut and the ball goes through to the keeper.
Shah played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Drives this full ball through the covers for single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Shorter in length, Shahidi goes in the crease and pulls it to the on side. Porterfield from mid on runs hard and stops it quickly. Just a run taken.
Floated outside turning in, Shahidi goes back and flicks it off his pads to the on side for a single.
Tossed up outside off, defended off the front foot. Replays showed it hit Shahidi first on the pad and then on the bat. No appeal from the bowler as the impact was clearly outside off.
Well outside off and on a length, Shah comes forward and pats the ball to the off side. Looks for a single but is sent back.
On a length, eased back down the ground but no run.
Outside off on a length, guided away to deep point for a run by the left-hander.
Slightly fuller on the pads, the ball is flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Left alone as the ball was way outside off.
On a length and middle stump line, defended solidly by Rahmat back down the ground.
Comes forward and keeps this one out.
Drives this tossed up delivery straight to mid off.
Fuller in length, guides to third man for a single.
Blocks this one off the front foot.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

FOUR! FIFTY for SHAH! It is also the first fifty by an Afghan in Test cricket. Other than one or two chances here and there, Shah has looked good in this innings. Can he continue it and get to the 3-figure mark? Coming to the ball, loose delivery outside off to start his over. Rahmat rocks back and pulls it hard to deep mid-wicket for a boundary. No stopping those.
Cameron Dow to bowl for the first time this morning.
A length ball on top of off, defended by HS on the back foot.
Pushed off the back foot wide of mid on for a single.
FOUR! Shot! Probably the shot of the morning so far for me. On the pads and Rahmat just flicks it away nonchalantly through mid-wicket for a boundary. The ball goes to the rope.
False shot but no risk there! A length ball outside off, Rahmat looks to cover drive this ball but it goes off the inner half and towards mid-wicket.
Short once more outside off, this time Hashmatullah cuts it away to deep point for a single.
On a shorter length outside off, Shahidi punches the ball towards cover.
Reads the line of this ball and blocks it straight to the bowler.
Flighted outside off, the batsman rocks back and cuts it to the point region. One run added to the total.
Driven a full ball straight to mid off and the batsmen scamper for a single.

FOUR! 50-run stand comes up between Shah and Shahidi! Coming to the ball, it was tossed up outside off, Shah comes down the track and lofts it straight to the long off fence. One bounce and four. Rahmat is getting in the groove now and has started to play his shots.
Prods forward and blocks it to the off side.
Tossed up on leg, worked fine on the on side. No run taken.
On the pads, turned away to the leg side by Shahidi.
A length ball on middle, punched back to bowler off the back foot.
This time, the ball is cut in the half for a couple of runs by Hashmatullah.
On a length outside off, punched towards cover by HS.
Defended off the front foot by Shahidi presenting the full face of the bat.
A length ball on middle, kept out by the batsman with a straight bat.

FOUR! Excellent! Flighted delivery on off, Shah reads it early and dances down the track to loft it straight and high above the bowler. The ball goes into the fence after bouncing just inside the ropes.
Gets right behind the line of the ball and blocks it.
The batsman charges down the track and plays it straight to mid off.
Defends this fuller ball straight to the covers.
Floated on leg stump line, Rahmat tries to sweep but does not connect well. It falls just short of backward short leg.
Tossed up outside off, pushed off the front foot towards covers. 1 run taken.

Drinks break! The Afghanistan batsmen have dug in in the first hour here. The Ireland bowlers have been relentless and plugged away, though without success. They would like a few wickets as the pitch is expected to ease off now and become better for batting as the afternoon comes upon us. Let us hope for more action in the period of play before Lunch.
Length ball pitching outside off, punched to the covers to end the over.
Length ball outside off. Left alone.
Shoulders arms to this full ball pitching way outside off.
Fuller in length, pushed to the on side. 1 run completed.
Full and on off, Shahidi goes back and plays it straight to the bowler.
Back of a length on off, Shahidi blocks it straight to mid off.
Driven by RS towards cover to end the over.
Flighted ball outside off, Shah comes ahead and defends that ball onto the ground.
A flatter one on middle, defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

Was that a chance? Yep! A flighted one well outside off, Rahmat makes room and looks to hit it over covers but the ball beats bat with the spin on it. The keeper fails to collect and there was a chance of a stumping. There was also a thin inside edge on that but the chance goes begging. The ball runs fine on the leg side for a couple. There was a run out appeal at the keeper's end but the batsman was well in.
Flatter one on middle, Shah comes ahead and keeps the ball out.
A little flight on middle, Rahmat has his dancing shoes on and looks to hit this one past the bowler. The ball is not timed too well and goes towards mid on.
Defends this off the front foot to the covers.

Full ball on off, punched off the back foot through the covers. Both the cover fielders give it a chase and Stirling from extra cover manages to stop it with a diving effort just inside the ropes. The batsmen complete a brace in the process.
Shorter length this time and on top of off stump, kept out back towards the bowler.
Length ball outside off, Shahidi comes ahead and defends it towards the leg side.
Goes back on this back of a length delivery and pushes it to the off side.
Starts off his day with a length ball on leg stump line. It was angling in, but Shahidi blocks it off the front foot.
Stuart Thompson is now on to bowl.
A good front foot defense to end the over. Dockrell keeping it nice and tight so far.
Flighted one on off, Shah comes down the track and takes it on the full. The ball is hit back to mid off. It feels really difficult out there to find the gap.

A false shot once more from Rahmat! Flighted outside off and Shah comes ahead and looks to drive but the ball goes off the outside half and slightly uppishly towards backward point. No worries though.
Slight turn on that one after landing on the off stump, Rahmat comes ahead and defends after covering the line of the ball.
Flatter one on the leg stump line, defended with a straight bat back towards the bowler.
Flighted ball outside off, driven to mid off on the front foot by Rahmat.
Full ball, flicked off his pads to the on side. A run completed.
Goes on the front foot to block this one.
Defends it by getting right behind the line of the ball.

In the air ... but safe! Bowls it a tad slower, the ball got stuck in the pitch. Rahmat tried to drive uppishly but hit it in the air at covers. Luckily no fielder was placed there and it was exactly in between the short mid off and the cover fielder.
Similar length, defended off the back foot.
Full ball on off. Rahmat plays a solid forward defence. The ball rolls on and hits the stumps at the non-strikers end.
Another dot to end the over. Fuller length on middle, pushed back to the bowler by Shahidi coming ahead.
Similar delivery and similarly kept out from the crease by the lefty.
Quicker through the air on middle and a bit of inward spin, Hashmatullah stands tall and defends.
Flighted and full on middle, driven off the front foot towards mid on. Good solid timing there!
Flatter ball on the stumps, pushed off the back foot towards mid on.
Flighted outside off, Shahidi comes down the track and hits it hard to mid off. The ball was well timed but not good placement there.
Back of a length delivery outside off, punched of the back foot to the covers.
Another drive but again straight to the fielder at cover. Similar result.
Drives this full ball straight to the fielder at silly mid off.
Pushed this one to mid on off the front foot.
Defended off the front foot to the covers.
Length ball on off, kept out by the batsman.
Flighted ball outside off, the batsman comes ahead and dead-bats this one.
Shorter this time and aimed at the top of off stump, kept out from the crease by the lefty.
Flatter one outside off, pushed away towards point.
FOUR! Little air on this and Hashmatullah comes down the track and hits the ball wide of mid on for a boundary. The ball was in the air but well away from the fielder.
Hurled on the middle stump line, nice and tight. Kept out back down the ground by Shahidi.
Flatter one at the pads, kept out towards mid-wicket.
Prods forward on this full delivery and defends it straight back to the bowler.
100 up for the Afghans! Shahidi tries to nudge this full ball on the leg side but gets it off the inside edge of the bat and goes to the fine leg region where the fielder picks it up. 1 run taken.
Goes on the the back foot to this length delivery and keeps it out on the off side.
Comes forward to a full length delivery and defends it to the ground.
Fuller in length, blocked out on the front foot.
Full length delivery pitching on leg, kept out by the batsman.

FOUR! The first boundary of the day. It comes off the bat of Rahmat Shah. A flighted one on leg stump, Rahmat dances down the track and takes it on the full before hitting it wide of mid on to his right. The ball runs away to the rope.
The ball is flatter on the off stump, pushed out towards the off side by Shah.
A flatter one outside off, pushed towards mid off by Rahmat who made room to play the shot. He must have looked to hit it a little more towards cover.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

Oooh! In the air... but away from the fielder at short leg. Flatter one outside off and turning inward, Shahidi looks to drive against the spin. The ball goes off the inside edge and wide of short leg uppishly. The batsmen pick up a single towards the left of mid-wicket.
Flighted outside off, Rahmat drives it hard to deep cover for a single.
Slower one outside off, defended to the covers.
Bowls it full and on off, Shahidi rocks back and drives to the point region but straight to the fielder.
Another dot this one. Blocked by the batsman to the on side.
Pitching outside leg, coming in with the angle, blocked just in front of his pads.
A bit shorter this time, defended watchfully.
Pitches it on a fuller length angling in, Shahidi lunges forward and defends it.
Decent delivery to end the over, just outside off and a little turn on offer. RS just gets closer to the ball before pushing it to cover.

Slightly airy on the leg stump line, Shah comes ahead to flick the ball but fails to put bat on it and gets hit on his pad. The ball though is going down leg and the umpire declines the appeal for the same reason.
A little shorter this time on the off stump line, pushed towards cover off the back foot by Rahmat.
Slightly quicker and a tad shorter, the ball grips a bit and turns but the batsman covers the spin and defends it.
Flatter ball on the off stump line, defended back towards the bowler.
From around the wicket, some air given outside the off stump. Rahmat drives it to the fielder at cover.
Shorter this one and outside off, Shahidi goes back and blocks it out to end the over. 1 from it.
Comes forward to this full ball and plays it with soft hands to the cover region for a single.
Bowls it fuller and outside off, Shah drives it crisply but it goes straight to the fielder at extra cover.
Gets it to come back in just a bit but Rahmat defends it to the covers.
Fuller and just outside off, Rahmat goes forward and blocks it.
Back of a length delivery outside off, defended firmly.
Flatter one on middle, pushed back down the ground for a single by Rahmat.
Flatter one outside off, cut away to deep point for a single by Hashmatullah. The first run of the day.
A good, solid defense on the back foot from Shahidi.

Flatter one outside off and a little turn into the southpaw. Shahidi comes ahead and pads it away offering no shot. The ball runs fine to the right of slip and to the boundary but the umpire signals it as a dead ball as there was no shot offered there.
Fuller on middle, pushed back to mid on by the lefty.
Bowled faster on a short length outside off, Shahidi defends off the back foot.
George Dockrell to bowl now, just one over for Andy Mcbrine.
Another maiden. Tad shorter outside off, Shah stands tall and blocks it. Two maidens in a row to start off the day.
Full and on leg, Rahmat shows no interest and keeps it out.
Slower than the last one, Shah prods forward and blocks it to the ground.
Fuller this time, defended off the front foot.
Another length ball but this time going down leg, Rahmat blocks it back to the bowler.
Murtagh starts off his day with a length ball on off, defended easily by Rahmat.
Tim Murtagh to bowl from the other end.
A front foot defense from Shahidi to end the first over, which is a maiden.
Flatter and slightly fuller on the off stump line, Shahidi takes a prod forward and defends the ball.
Quicker through the air outside off, the southpaw keeps it out watchfully.
Flatter one just outside the off stump line, Hashmatullah comes ahead and defends the ball onto the ground.
Another one just on the off stump line, the batsman stands in the crease and defends the ball.
Flatter one outside off to start off, Shahidi pushes the ball to covers.
We are all set for the first ball of Day 2. Hashmatullah Shahidi and Rahmat Shah to continue batting for Afghanistan whereas Andy McBrine has the ball in hand for Ireland. Let's play...

PITCH REPORT - The pitch expert says that the pitch has runs on offer and that it also has wickets on offer for both type of bowlers. Coming to the surface, he says that there is a tinge of green. As a batsman, he says one must apply themselves to score runs there. As for the bowlers, they will still get help he reckons but in the end, he says that it is all about application.

Rashid Khan is on the sidelines for an interview, he feels that their bowlers did really well to restrict the Irish to 180. He is happy to have just lost 2 wickets by the end of the day. Mentions they are looking to reach a lead of 150 minimum and then take it forward from there. About the pitch he tells us that it took spin as well. Informs us that there was a slight injury to his finger while bowling but hopes he will recover in time to bowl in the second innings.

Welcome to the coverage of action on Day 2 in this one-off Test between Afghanistan and Ireland. The first day was a really fast-paced one and we saw 12 wickets fall. The 'hosts' were well-placed at Stumps and trail by just 82 runs now. They know a couple of good partnerships will propel them into a sizeable lead. The Irish, on the other hand, will need quick wickets to remain in the game. The surface is one which is playing tricks and will only get tougher to bat on. First ball of the day is not too far away...
... Day 2, Session 1 ...

What will the two sides be looking for on Day 2? Afghanistan - they will be looking to get two good stands and that should probably put them in a commanding position in this Test. The visitors will need wickets and that too quickly or they might just face an uphill task getting back into the game. Join us for all the action at 1000 local (0430 GMT). Till then, take care and goodbye.

Earlier in the day, had it not been for the 10th wicket, 87-run stand, between Dockrell and Murtagh, Ireland would be way behind the 8-ball game. They were reeling at 85 for 9 after the Afghan bowlers wrecked havoc. However, a half ton from Murtagh ensured some respectability to their score. Afghanistan's pursuit of taking a lead has started off in good fashion though and at the end of Day 1, it is them who are on top.

Afghanistan's day without a doubt. However, the visitors are not completely out of it. A couple of timely wickets has seen them hang in there. Both have gone to the debutant, Cameron Dow. He first got Ihsanullah for not a lot and then just as when Shahzad started to get going, he dismissed the opener with a fantastic catch. Shahidi and Shah though have ensured there are no more wickets to fall. The two are amidst a 22-run stand and have cut down the deficit to 82 runs.
A single to end the day's play as Shahidi slaps it through covers for a run. THAT WILL BE STUMPS ON DAY 1!
Beaten! Pitches outside off and turns in. Shahidi looks to play at it but fails to read the line of the delivery. In the process, fails to get bat on ball.
Lands it outside off, Shahidi cuts it superbly to the sweeper cover region. And three fielders race to fetch it. The batsmen collect a brace.
Shahidi defends it firmly onto the ground.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Tossed up outside off, Shahidi looks to defend but gets an outside edge. It falls just short and to the left of first slip. He does well to stop it.
George Dockrell to bowl what probably is the last over of the day.
A back of a length delivery, pitched on off, pushed away by Shah towards mid off.
Full on middle and leg, Shah works it to the leg side.
A short pitch delivery on off, defended on the back foot.
A short of a length delivery on off, Shah pushes it to the cover region.
Length ball on leg, Shah flicks it straight to mid-wicket.

Back of a length delivery, pitched on leg and nibbling down the leg for the lefty, Shahidi wanted to flick but failed, and the ball hits his thigh pad. The ball goes to mid-wicket and batsmen take a run. Leg bye signaled by the umpire.
Shah rocks back and keeps it out. Afghanistan still trail by 86 runs.
Again blocked off boldly by the batsman.
Floated outside off, Shahidi steers it to point and bags a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Lands it around leg, blocked firmly.
Flatter on middle, Shahidi defends it out to the leg side.
Length delivery, pitched outside off, left alone by Shah.
Full on off, defended.
No ball! ST overstepping on that. A short pitch delivery outside off, Shahidi cuts it to the point region and takes a single.
A back of a length delivery on off, defended on the back foot.
Short of a length delivery, Shahidi blocks it with ease.
A back of a length delivery, played straight down to the bowler.
A short pitch delivery on off, Shahidi was looking for a cut. The ball was too close to the body to play, ends up getting an inside edge onto the ground.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! Smashed! Shah charges forward to this and heaves it over the mid on fielder. The ball rolls over the ropes. A boundary results.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Shah charges forward and looks to heave but gets an inside as the ball runs down the square leg region.
Rolls his fingers on this one but pitches it full. Shah defends it firmly.
Floated up on off, the batsman defends it onto the ground.
Short of a good length delivery, Shahidi defends it from the back foot.
Full on off, blocked by Shahidi.
A back of a length delivery around off, defended.
Full length ball pitched on middle and leg, Shahidi flicks it to mid-wicket.
Down the leg side. Pitched outside leg and shapes away, Shahidi was looking for a flick but fails, a good gather by the keeper.
A full length outside off, left alone by Shahidi.
Onto the pads, Shahidi flicks it to the square leg region and take a single. The deficit is now 93 runs.
Fullish on middle, defends it firmly.
Shahidi prods forward and defends it onto the ground.
Flatter and outside off, Shahidi cuts it to point and takes a single. They collect a brace.
The batsman has punched the ball back to the bowler.
Tossed up around off, Shahidi plants his front foot forward and blocks it.
Well left. Pitched this one way outside off, Shah shoulders arms.
Back of a length delivery, pushed to the on side.
Similar length, this time driven to the cover fielder.
Full ball outside off, Shah punches it straight to extra cover.
Length delivery again and the batter defends it onto the ground.
Pitched on off, it is blocked.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Short and outside off, Shahidi goes back and slaps it through covers for a boundary.
Outside off, it has been left alone.
Floats it up on middle, Shahidi lunges and defends it out.
On the stumps, the batter goes back and keeps it out.
Goes back and punches it down to long off for a run.
Short and on middle, it is pulled towards fine leg for a run.
Dot to end the over. Bit ahead of a full length, Rahmat defends it firmly.
No ball! Thompson oversteps. Fullish and outside off, Rahmat defends it. An extra ball to follow.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Outside off again, Rahmat drives it to the covers fielder and a yes-no between the batsmen. Finally they decide not to run.
Length ball around off, the batsman defends it on his back foot.
Outside off, Shahidi drives it to covers.

Loud Appeal .... Not Out given! Full ball pitching on leg, goes down with the angle, Shah tries to play it on the on side but misses to get bat on ball. Thompson has a loud appeal on this one for an lbw. The umpire shakes his head.
Stuart Thompson is on now.
Outside off and it has been left alone.
Floats it up on off, it is kept out. The bowler though has overstepped and it has been called a no ball.

OUT! WHAT A CATCH! Ho ho ho, that has stuck. Shahzad can't believe it and a timely wicket this as the partnership was looking threatening. MS uses his feet and absolutely smashes it low towards the bowler. Cameron Dow reacts quickly, gets low and takes it wonderfully. Throws the ball up in the air in delight. He gets his second. Afghanistan now have lost both their openers as Shahzad falls 10 short of a half ton. The hosts trail by another 104 runs.
FOUR! OVER! Uses his feet and gets to the pitch of the ball. He lofts it over mid on's head for a boundary.
EDGED? Outside off, flattish, Rahmat looks to guide it to off but misses. An appeal from the players but the umpire is unmoved.
Another sweep from Shahzad. Outside off, a bit fuller, Shahzad sweeps it neat as the ball runs down the fine leg. A good effort by the fielder to stop it before the ropes. The batsmen take two.
Tossed up on leg, pushed back to the bowler.
Plays out the last ball with a front foot defence.
FOUR! Two in two! Shah rocks back to this short ball and pulls it hard to the deep mid-wicket region. No fielder in that area. Easy boundary.
FOUR! Beautiful Placement! Hits the ball with the full face of the bat and drives it straight to the right of the bowler. The ball races away to the long on fence. Boundary signaled.
Defended off the front foot straight to the bowler.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Goes down the track on this one and clips it to the fielder at short mid wicket.
Tossed up around off, the batter punches it back to the bowler.
Lands it outside leg, Rahmat sweeps it behind the keeper and collects a brace.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Shahzad taps it back to the left of the bowler.
FOUR! Smartly done by Shahzad. Outside off, opens the face of the bat very late and directs it to the third man region.
Flatter on middle, defends it off his front foot.
Full on off, defended watchfully.
A loopy full length delivery on off, Shah was waiting with a defense stride but gets an outside edge and the ball races away to the third man region. Batsman runs two.
Full on off, defended.
A flighted delivery on off, blocked by Rahmat.

OUT! Cameron Dow draws the first blood. Maiden Test wicket for him and he announces himself in the international scenario. He angled the ball in, the ball pitched in line of the stumps and hit Ihsanullah's pad as he tries to defend. An appeal follows and the umpire agrees. Early wicket for Ireland, just the start they wanted.
